payload.name: Image Dimensions 600x600 Upload Fix by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 600 x 600 image resize and crop fix for blocked upload forms.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 600 x 600 image resize and crop fixer for people blocked by school forms, profile photos, marketplace listings, and application portals that require exact square dimensions. It points to local resize, crop, and image compression tools, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 manual upload fix-plan request only after a public-safe fit check.
